```sql
SELECT AVG(ym.Consumption) 
FROM main."transactions_1k" t
JOIN main."yearmonth" ym ON t."CustomerID" = ym."CustomerID"
WHERE t."Date" >= DATE '2013-03-04' 
  AND t."Date" <= DATE '2013-03-10'
  AND ym."Date" LIKE '2013-03%';
```
